ayahs.ar: قَدۡ اَفۡلَحَ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qad aflahal mu'minoon
ayahs.en: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ فِيۡ صَلَاتِهِمۡ خٰشِعُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena hum fee Salaatihim khaashi'oon
ayahs.en: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عَنِ اللَّغۡوِ مُعۡرِضُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena hum 'anillaghwimu'ridoon
ayahs.en: And they who turn away from ill speech

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِلزَّكٰوةِ فٰعِلُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena hum liz Zakaati faa'iloon
ayahs.en: And they who are observant of zakah

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوۡجِهِمۡ حٰفِظُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena hum lifuroo jihim haafizoon
ayahs.en: And they who guard their private parts

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا عَلٰ٘ي اَزۡوَاجِهِمۡ اَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ اَيۡمَانُهُمۡ فَاِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُوۡمِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Illaa 'alaaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aimaanuhum fa innahum ghairu maloomeen
ayahs.en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -

ayahs.ar: فَمَنِ ابۡتَغٰي وَرَآءَ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡعٰدُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Famanib taghaa waraaa'a zaalika fa ulaaa'ika humul 'aadoon
ayahs.en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِاَمٰنٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رٰعُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena hum li amaanaatihim wa 'ahdihim raa'oon
ayahs.en: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عَلٰي صَلَوٰتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُوۡنَۘ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena hum 'alaa Salawaatihim yuhaafizoon
ayahs.en: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡوٰرِثُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ika humul waarisoon
ayahs.en: Those are the inheritors

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَرِثُوۡنَ الۡفِرۡدَوۡسَؕ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yarisoonal Firdawsa hum feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.en: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنۡ طِيۡنٍۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana min sulaalatim minteen
ayahs.en: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنٰهُ نُطۡفَةً فِيۡ قَرَارٍ مَّكِيۡنٍࣕ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa ja'alnaahu nutfatan fee qaraarim makeen
ayahs.en: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ خَلَقۡنَا النُّطۡفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقۡنَا الۡعَلَقَةَ مُضۡغَةً فَخَلَقۡنَا الۡمُضۡغَةَ عِظٰمًا فَكَسَوۡنَا الۡعِظٰمَ لَحۡمًاࣗ ثُمَّ اَنۡشَاۡنٰهُ خَلۡقًا اٰخَرَؕ فَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ اَحۡسَنُ الۡخٰلِقِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa khalaqnan nutfata 'alaqatan fakhalaqnal 'alaqata mudghatan fakhalaq nal mudghata 'izaaman fakasawnal 'izaama lahman summa anshaanaahu khalqan aakhar; fatabaarakal laahu ahsanul khaaliqeen
ayahs.en: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمۡ بَعۡدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa innakum ba'da zaalika la maaiyitoon
ayahs.en: Then indeed, after that you are to die.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ تُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa innakum Yawmal Qiyaamati tub'asoon
ayahs.en: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعَ طَرَآئِقَࣗۖ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الۡخَلۡقِ غٰفِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad khalaqnaa fawqakum sab'a taraaa'iqa wa maa kunnaa 'anil khalqi ghaafileen
ayahs.en: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.

ayahs.ar: وَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ بِقَدَرٍ فَاَسۡكَنّٰهُ فِي الۡاَرۡضِࣗۖ وَاِنَّا عَلٰي ذَهَابٍۭ بِهٖ لَقٰدِرُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am biqadarin fa-askannaahu fil ardi wa innaa 'alaa zahaabim bihee laqaa diroon
ayahs.en: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.

ayahs.ar: فَاَنۡشَاۡنَا لَكُمۡ بِهٖ جَنّٰتٍ مِّنۡ نَّخِيۡلٍ وَّاَعۡنَابٍۘ لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيۡرَةٌ وَّمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa anshaanaa lakum bihee Jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naab; lakum feehaa fawaakihu kaseeratunw wa minhaa taakuloon
ayahs.en: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.

ayahs.ar: وَشَجَرَةً تَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ طُوۡرِ سَيۡنَآءَ تَنۭۡ بُتُ بِالدُّهۡنِ وَصِبۡغٍ لِّلۡاٰكِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa shajaratan takhruju min Toori Sainaaa'a tambutu bidduhni wa sibghil lil aakileen
ayahs.en: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِي الۡاَنۡعَامِ لَعِبۡرَةًؕ نُسۡقِيۡكُمۡ مِّمَّا فِيۡ بُطُوۡنِهَا وَلَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيۡرَةٌ وَّمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa inna lakum fil an'aami la'ibrah; nusqeekum mimmaa fee butoonihaa wa lakum feehaa manaafi'u kaseeratunw wa minhaa taakuloon
ayahs.en: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.

ayahs.ar: وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَي الۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa 'alaihaa wa'alal fulki tuhmaloon
ayahs.en: And upon them and on ships you are carried.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ فَقَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee faqaala yaa qawmi'budul laaha maa lakum min ilahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon
ayahs.en: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ الۡمَلَؤُا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ مَا هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۙ يُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يَّتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡؕ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَاَنۡزَلَ مَلٰٓئِكَةًۚۖ مَّا سَمِعۡنَا بِهٰذَا فِيۡ٘ اٰبَآئِنَا الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Faqaalal mala'ul lazeena kafaroo min qawmihee maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yureedu ai yatafaddala 'alaikum wa law shaaa'al laahu la anzala malaaa'ikatam maa sami'naa bihaazaa feee aabaaa'inal awwaleen
ayahs.en: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلٌۭ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوۡا بِهٖ حَتّٰي حِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: In huwa illaa rajulum bihee jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihee hattan heen
ayahs.en: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ انۡصُرۡنِيۡ بِمَا كَذَّبُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbin surnee bimaa kazzaboon
ayahs.en: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

ayahs.ar: فَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِ اَنِ اصۡنَعِ الۡفُلۡكَ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّوۡرُۙ فَاسۡلُكۡ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلٍّ زَوۡجَيۡنِ اثۡنَيۡنِ وَاَهۡلَكَ اِلَّا مَنۡ سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ الۡقَوۡلُ مِنۡهُمۡۚ وَلَا تُخَاطِبۡنِيۡ فِي الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡاۚ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّغۡرَقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa awhainaaa ilaihi anis na'il fulka bi a'yuninaa wa wahyinaa fa izaa jaaa'a amrunaa wa faarat tannooru fasluk feehaa min kullin zawjainis naini wa ahlaka illaa man sabaqa 'alaihil qawlu minhum wa laa tukhaat ibnee fil lazeena zalamooo innaahum mughraqoon
ayahs.en: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.

ayahs.ar: فَاِذَا اسۡتَوَيۡتَ اَنۡتَ وَمَنۡ مَّعَكَ عَلَي الۡفُلۡكِ فَقُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ نَجّٰىنَا مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa izas tawaita ata wa mam ma'aka 'alal fulki faqulil hamdu lillaahil lazee najjaanaa minal qawmiz zalimeen
ayahs.en: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'

ayahs.ar: وَقُلۡ رَّبِّ اَنۡزِلۡنِيۡ مُنۡزَلًا مُّبٰرَكًا وَّاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الۡمُنۡزِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qur Rabbi anzilnee munzalam mubaarakanw wa Anta khairul munzileen
ayahs.en: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ وَّاِنۡ كُنَّا لَمُبۡتَلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaatinw wa in kunnaa lamubtaleen
ayahs.en: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اَنۡشَاۡنَا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قَرۡنًا اٰخَرِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Summaa anshaana mim ba'dihim qarnan aakhareen
ayahs.en: Then We produced after them a generation of others.

ayahs.ar: فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيۡهِمۡ رَسُوۡلًا مِّنۡهُمۡ اَنِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa arsalnaa feehim Rasoolam minhum ani'budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon
ayahs.en: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الۡمَلَاُ مِنۡ قَوۡمِهِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَكَذَّبُوۡا بِلِقَآءِ الۡاٰخِرَةِ وَاَتۡرَفۡنٰهُمۡ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۙ مَا هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۙ يَاۡكُلُ مِمَّا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَيَشۡرَبُ مِمَّا تَشۡرَبُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal mala-u min qawmihil lazeena kafaroo wa kazzaboo bi liqaaa'il Aakhirati wa atrafnaahum fil hayaatid dunyaa maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yaakulu mimmaa taakuloona minhu wa yashrabu mimmaa tashraboon
ayahs.en: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَطَعۡتُمۡ بَشَرًا مِّثۡلَكُمۡۙ اِنَّكُمۡ اِذًا لَّخٰسِرُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa la'in at'atum basharam mislakum innakum izal lakhaasiroon
ayahs.en: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.

ayahs.ar: اَيَعِدُكُمۡ اَنَّكُمۡ اِذَا مِتُّمۡ وَكُنۡتُمۡ تُرَابًا وَّعِظَامًا اَنَّكُمۡ مُّخۡرَجُوۡنَࣕۙ‏
ayahs.tl: A-Ya'idukum annakum izaa mittum wa kuntum turaabanw wa izaaman annakum mukhrajoon
ayahs.en: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?

ayahs.ar: هَيۡهَاتَ هَيۡهَاتَ لِمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَࣕۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Haihaata haihaata limaa too'adoon
ayahs.en: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ هِيَ اِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنۡيَا نَمُوۡتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوۡثِيۡنَࣕۙ‏
ayahs.tl: In hiya illaa hayaatunad dunyaa namootu wa nahyaa wa maa nahnu bimab'ooseen
ayahs.en: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلُ اِۨفۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا وَّمَا نَحۡنُ لَهٗ بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: In huwa illaa rajulunif taraa 'alal laahi kazibanw wa maa nahnuu lahoo bimu'mineen
ayahs.en: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ انۡصُرۡنِيۡ بِمَا كَذَّبُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbin surnee bimaa kazzaboon
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيۡلٍ لَّيُصۡبِحُنَّ نٰدِمِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala 'ammaa qaleelil la yusbihunna naadimeen
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."

ayahs.ar: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصَّيۡحَةُ بِالۡحَقِّ فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ غُثَآءًۚ فَبُعۡدًا لِّلۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa akhazat humus saihatu bilhaqqi faja'alnaahum ghusaaa'aa; fabu;dal lilqaw miz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اَنۡشَاۡنَا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قُرُوۡنًا اٰخَرِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa anshaanaa mim ba'dihim quroonan aakhareen
ayahs.en: Then We produced after them other generations.

ayahs.ar: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَاۡخِرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wa maa yastaakhiroon
ayahs.en: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتۡرَاؕ كُلَّمَا جَآءَ اُمَّةً رَّسُوۡلُهَا كَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَتۡبَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ بَعۡضًا وَّجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ اَحَادِيۡثَۚ فَبُعۡدًا لِّقَوۡمٍ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa arsalnaa Rusulanaa tatraa kulla maa jaaa'a ummatar Rasooluhaa kazzabooh; fa atba'naa ba'dahum ba'danw wa ja'alnaahum ahaadees; fabu'dal liqawmil laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰي وَاَخَاهُ هٰرُوۡنَ ࣢ۙ بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa arsalnaa Moosaa wa akhaahu Haaroona bi Aayaatinaa wa sultaanim mubeen
ayahs.en: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority

ayahs.ar: اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۠ئِهٖ فَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا عَالِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Ilaa Fir'awna wa mala'ihee fastakbaroo wa kaanoo qawman 'aaleem
ayahs.en: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.

ayahs.ar: فَقَالُوۡ٘ا اَنُؤۡمِنُ لِبَشَرَيۡنِ مِثۡلِنَا وَقَوۡمُهُمَا لَنَا عٰبِدُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Faqaaloo annu'minu libasharaini mislinaa wa qawmuhumaa lanaa 'aabidoon
ayahs.en: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُمَا فَكَانُوۡا مِنَ الۡمُهۡلَكِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fakazzaboohumaa fakaanoo minal mmuhlakeen
ayahs.en: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba la'allahum yahtadoon
ayahs.en: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا ابۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ وَاُمَّهٗ٘ اٰيَةً وَّاٰوَيۡنٰهُمَا٘ اِلٰي رَبۡوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَّمَعِيۡنٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'alnab na Maryama wa ummahooo aayatannw wa aawainaahumaaa ilaa rabwatin zaati qaraarinw wa ma'een
ayahs.en: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوۡا مِنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَاعۡمَلُوۡا صَالِحًاؕ اِنِّيۡ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ عَلِيۡمٌؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaaa aiyuhar Rusulu kuloo minat taiyibaati wa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona 'Aleem
ayahs.en: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ هٰذِهٖ٘ اُمَّتُكُمۡ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّاَنَا رَبُّكُمۡ فَاتَّقُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Wa inna haaziheee ummatukum ummatanw waahidatanw wa Ana Rabbukum fattaqoon
ayahs.en: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."

ayahs.ar: فَتَقَطَّعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَهُمۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ زُبُرًاؕ كُلُّ حِزۡبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fataqatta'ooo amrahum bainahum zuburaa; kullu hizbim bimaa ladaihim farihoon
ayahs.en: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.

ayahs.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ فِيۡ غَمۡرَتِهِمۡ حَتّٰي حِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Fazarhum fee ghamratihim hattaa heen
ayahs.en: So leave them in their confusion for a time.

ayahs.ar: اَيَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمۡ بِهٖ مِنۡ مَّالٍ وَّبَنِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: A-yahsaboona annnamaa numiduhum bihee mimmaalinw wa baneen
ayahs.en: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children

ayahs.ar: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمۡ فِي الۡخَيۡرٰتِؕ بَلۡ لَّا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Nusaari'u lahum fil khairaat; bal laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ رَبِّهِمۡ مُّشۡفِقُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena hum min khashyati Rabbihim mushfiqoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena hum bi Aayaati Rabbihim yu'minoon
ayahs.en: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ بِرَبِّهِمۡ لَا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena hum bi Rabbihim laa yushrikoon
ayahs.en: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يُؤۡتُوۡنَ مَا٘ اٰتَوۡا وَّقُلُوۡبُهُمۡ وَجِلَةٌ اَنَّهُمۡ اِلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ رٰجِعُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena yu'toona maaa aataw wa quloobuhum wajilatun annahum ilaa Rabbihim raaji'oon
ayahs.en: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ يُسٰرِعُوۡنَ فِي الۡخَيۡرٰتِ وَهُمۡ لَهَا سٰبِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ika yusaari'oona fil khairaati wa hum lahaa saabiqoon
ayahs.en: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا اِلَّا وُسۡعَهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا كِتٰبٌ يَّنۡطِقُ بِالۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa wa ladainaa kitaabuny yantiqu bilhaqqi w ahum la yuzlamoon
ayahs.en: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ قُلُوۡبُهُمۡ فِيۡ غَمۡرَةٍ مِّنۡ هٰذَا وَلَهُمۡ اَعۡمَالٌ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ ذٰلِكَ هُمۡ لَهَا عٰمِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratim min haazaa wa lahum a'maalum min dooni zaalika hum lahaa 'aamiloon
ayahs.en: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا٘ اَخَذۡنَا مُتۡرَفِيۡهِمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ اِذَا هُمۡ يَجۡـَٔرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izaaa akhznaa mutrafeehim bil'azaabi izaa hum yaj'aroon
ayahs.en: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help.

ayahs.ar: لَا تَجۡـَٔرُوا الۡيَوۡمَࣞ اِنَّكُمۡ مِّنَّا لَا تُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laa taj'arul yawma innakum minnaa laa tunsaroon
ayahs.en: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.

ayahs.ar: قَدۡ كَانَتۡ اٰيٰتِيۡ تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنۡتُمۡ عَلٰ٘ي اَعۡقَابِكُمۡ تَنۡكِصُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qad kaanat Aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum 'alaaa a'qaabikum tankisoon
ayahs.en: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels

ayahs.ar: مُسۡتَكۡبِرِيۡنَࣗۚۖ بِهٖ سٰمِرًا تَهۡجُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Mustakbireena bihee saamiran tahjuroon
ayahs.en: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.

ayahs.ar: اَفَلَمۡ يَدَّبَّرُوا الۡقَوۡلَ اَمۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مَّا لَمۡ يَاۡتِ اٰبَآءَهُمُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَؗ‏
ayahs.tl: Afalam yaddabbarrul qawla am jaaa'ahum maa lam yaati aabaaa'ahumul awwaleen
ayahs.en: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ لَمۡ يَعۡرِفُوۡا رَسُوۡلَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَهٗ مُنۡكِرُوۡنَؗ‏
ayahs.tl: Am lam ya'rifoo Rasoolahum fahum lahoo munkiroon
ayahs.en: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌؕ بَلۡ جَآءَهُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَاَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كٰرِهُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Am yaqooloona bihee jinnnah; bal jaaa'ahum bilhaqqi wa aksaruhum lil haqqi kaarihoon
ayahs.en: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الۡحَقُّ اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ وَمَنۡ فِيۡهِنَّؕ بَلۡ اَتَيۡنٰهُمۡ بِذِكۡرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِهِمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lawit taba'al haqqu ahwaaa'ahum lafasadatis samaawaatu wal ardu wa man feehinnn; bal atainaahum bizikrihim fahum 'an zikrihim mu'ridon
ayahs.en: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ خَرۡجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٌࣗۖ وَّهُوَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰزِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharaaju Rabbika khairunw wa Huwa khairur raaziqeen
ayahs.en: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّكَ لَتَدۡعُوۡهُمۡ اِلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa innaka latad'oohum ilaa Siraatim Mustaqeem
ayahs.en: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنٰكِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa innnal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil Aakhirati 'anis siraati lanaakiboon
ayahs.en: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ رَحِمۡنٰهُمۡ وَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِمۡ مِّنۡ ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوۡا فِيۡ طُغۡيَانِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law rahimnaahum wa kashafnaa maa bihim min durril lalajjoo fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
ayahs.en: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ فَمَا اسۡتَكَانُوۡا لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad akhaznaahum bil'azaabi famastakaanoo li Rabbihim wa maa yatadarra'oon
ayahs.en: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيۡدٍ اِذَا هُمۡ فِيۡهِ مُبۡلِسُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izaa fatahnaa 'alaihim baaban zaa 'azaabin shadeedin izaa hum feehi mublisoon
ayahs.en: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡشَاَ لَكُمُ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡاَبۡصَارَ وَالۡاَفۡـِٕدَةَؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal lazeee ansha a-lakumus sam'a wal absaara wal af'idah; qaleelam maa tashkuroon
ayahs.en: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ ذَرَاَكُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal lazee zara akum fil ardi wa ilaihi tuhsharoon
ayahs.en: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ يُحۡيٖ وَيُمِيۡتُ وَلَهُ اخۡتِلَافُ الَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal lazee yuhyee wa yumeetu wa lahukh tilaaful laili wannahaar; afalaa ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ قَالُوۡا مِثۡلَ مَا قَالَ الۡاَوَّلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Bal qaaloo misla maa qaalal awwaloon
ayahs.en: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَّعِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوۡثُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo 'a-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'a-innaa lamab 'oosoon
ayahs.en: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا نَحۡنُ وَاٰبَآؤُنَا هٰذَا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا٘ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laqad wu'idnaa nahnu wa aabaaa'unaa haazaa min qablu in haazaaa illaaa asaateerul awwaleen
ayahs.en: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ لِّمَنِ الۡاَرۡضُ وَمَنۡ فِيۡهَا٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul limanil ardu wa man feehaaa in kuntum ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِؕ قُلۡ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Sa-yaqooloona lillaah; qul afalaa tazakkkaroon
ayahs.en: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ رَّبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ السَّبۡعِ وَرَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Qul mar Rabbus samaawaatis sab'i wa Rabbul 'Arshil 'Azeem
ayahs.en: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِؕ قُلۡ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Sa yaqooloona lillaah; qul afalaa tattaqoon
ayahs.en: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَنۭۡ بِيَدِهٖ مَلَكُوۡتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ وَّهُوَ يُجِيۡرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيۡهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul mam bi yadihee malakootu kulli shai'inw wa Huwa yujeeru wa laa yujaaru 'alaihi in kuntum ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِؕ قُلۡ فَاَنّٰي تُسۡحَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Sa yaqooloona lillaah; qul fa annaa tus haroon
ayahs.en: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ اَتَيۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَكٰذِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Bal atainaahum bil haqqi wa innahum lakaaziboon
ayahs.en: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.

ayahs.ar: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ وَّلَدٍ وَّمَا كَانَ مَعَهٗ مِنۡ اِلٰهٍ اِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ اِلٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلٰي بَعۡضٍؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Mat takhazal laahu minw waladinw wa maa kaana ma'ahoo min ilaah; izal lazahaba kullu ilaahim bimaa khalaqa wa la'alaa ba'duhum 'alaa ba'd; Subhaannal laahi 'ammaa yasifoon
ayahs.en: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him].

ayahs.ar: عٰلِمِ الۡغَيۡبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعٰلٰي عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: 'Aalimil Ghaibi wash shahhaadati fata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon
ayahs.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ رَّبِّ اِمَّا تُرِيَنِّيۡ مَا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qur Rabbi immmaa turiyannee maa yoo'adoon
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِيۡ فِي الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Rabbi falaa taj'alnee fil qawmiz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّا عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمۡ لَقٰدِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa innaa 'alaaa an nuriyaka maa na'iduhum laqaadiroon
ayahs.en: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them.

ayahs.ar: اِدۡفَعۡ بِالَّتِيۡ هِيَ اَحۡسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَؕ نَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Idfa' billate hiya ahsanus saiyi'ah; nahnu a'lamu bimaa yasifoon
ayahs.en: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.

ayahs.ar: وَقُلۡ رَّبِّ اَعُوۡذُ بِكَ مِنۡ هَمَزٰتِ الشَّيٰطِيۡنِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qur Rabbi a'oozu bika min hamazaatish Shayaateen
ayahs.en: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,

ayahs.ar: وَاَعُوۡذُ بِكَ رَبِّ اَنۡ يَّحۡضُرُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Wa a'oozu bika Rabbi ai-yahduroon
ayahs.en: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَآءَ اَحَدَهُمُ الۡمَوۡتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارۡجِعُوۡنِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'a ahada humul mawtu qaala Rabbir ji'oon
ayahs.en: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back

ayahs.ar: لَعَلِّيۡ٘ اَعۡمَلُ صَالِحًا فِيۡمَا تَرَكۡتُ كَلَّاؕ اِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَاؕ وَمِنۡ وَّرَآئِهِمۡ بَرۡزَخٌ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: La'alleee a'malu saalihan feemaa taraktu kallaa; innahaa kalimatun huwa qaaa'iluhaa wa minw waraaa'him barzakhun ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon
ayahs.en: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.

ayahs.ar: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّوۡرِ فَلَا٘ اَنۡسَابَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ وَّلَا يَتَسَآءَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa izaa nufikha fis Soori falaaa ansaaba bainahum yawma'izinw wa laa yatasaaa'aloon
ayahs.en: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.

ayahs.ar: فَمَنۡ ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَازِيۡنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faman saqulat mawaazee nuhoo fa ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon
ayahs.en: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَازِيۡنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ خَسِرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ فِيۡ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa man khaffat mawaa zeenuhoo fa ulaaa'ikal lazeena khasiroon anfusahum fee Jahannnama khaalidoon
ayahs.en: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.

ayahs.ar: تَلۡفَحُ وُجُوۡهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا كٰلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Talfahu wujoohahumun Naaru wa hum feehaa kaalihood
ayahs.en: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ اٰيٰتِيۡ تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنۡتُمۡ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Alam takun Aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum bihaa tukazziboon
ayahs.en: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتۡ عَلَيۡنَا شِقۡوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوۡمًا ضَآلِّيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo Rabbanaa ghalabat 'alainaa shiqwatunaa wa kunnaa qawman daaalleen
ayahs.en: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَا٘ اَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡهَا فَاِنۡ عُدۡنَا فَاِنَّا ظٰلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Rabbanaa akhrijnaa minhaa fa in 'udnaa fa innaa zaalimoon
ayahs.en: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اخۡسَـُٔوۡا فِيۡهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Qaalakh sa'oo feehaa wa laa tukallimoon
ayahs.en: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ فَرِيۡقٌ مِّنۡ عِبَادِيۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ رَبَّنَا٘ اٰمَنَّا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَارۡحَمۡنَا وَاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innahoo kaana fareequm min 'ibaadee yaqooloona Rabbanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa Anta khairur raahimeen
ayahs.en: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'

ayahs.ar: فَاتَّخَذۡتُمُوۡهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا حَتّٰ٘ي اَنۡسَوۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرِيۡ وَكُنۡتُمۡ مِّنۡهُمۡ تَضۡحَكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fattakhaztumoohum sikhriyyan hattaaa ansawkum zikree wa kuntum minhum tadhakoon
ayahs.en: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.

ayahs.ar: اِنِّيۡ جَزَيۡتُهُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡ٘اۙ اَنَّهُمۡ هُمُ الۡفَآئِزُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inee jazaituhumul Yawma bimaa sabarooo annahum humul faaa'izoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."

ayahs.ar: قٰلَ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ عَدَدَ سِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala kam labistum fil ardi 'adada sineen
ayahs.en: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا اَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمٍ فَسۡـَٔلِ الۡعَآدِّيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo labisnaa yawman aw ba'da yawmin fas'alil 'aaaddeen
ayahs.en: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."

ayahs.ar: قٰلَ اِنۡ لَّبِثۡتُمۡ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا لَّوۡ اَنَّكُمۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala il labistum illaa qaleelal law annakum kuntum ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.

ayahs.ar: اَفَحَسِبۡتُمۡ اَنَّمَا خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ عَبَثًا وَّاَنَّكُمۡ اِلَيۡنَا لَا تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Afahsibtum annamaa khalaqnaakum 'abasanw wa annakum ilainaa laa turja'oon
ayahs.en: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"

ayahs.ar: فَتَعٰلَي اللّٰهُ الۡمَلِكُ الۡحَقُّۚ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۚ رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡكَرِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Fata'aalal laahul Malikul Haqq; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil Kareem
ayahs.en: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّدۡعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۙ لَا بُرۡهَانَ لَهٗ بِهٖۙ فَاِنَّمَا حِسَابُهٗ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُفۡلِحُ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa mai yad'u ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara laa burhaana lahoo bihee fa innnamaa hisaabuhoo 'inda Rabbih; innahoo laa yuflihul kaafiroon
ayahs.en: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.

ayahs.ar: وَقُلۡ رَّبِّ اغۡفِرۡ وَارۡحَمۡ وَاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qur Rabbigh fir warham wa Anta khairur raahimeen
ayahs.en: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
